# Security

Please do not report a security problem in an issue, a pull request, a portal (including the app's Security and Bug Reports portals) or a chat.

Report it privately: open the **Security** tab of the repository where the problem lies and choose **Report a vulnerability**. For the chain, that is [pixagram-blockchain/pixagram](https://github.com/pixagram-blockchain/pixagram); for the app, [pixagram-blockchain/pixagram-ui-dev](https://github.com/pixagram-blockchain/pixagram-ui-dev); for the documentation, this repository.

Include the component and the commit or version, the steps to reproduce the problem, and what an attacker could do. The report stays private until a fix is live; the documentation describes it only after that. Details: [Report a security problem](../22-about/contributing.md#report-a-security-problem).
